cover: Questions to settle before you buy AI search

slides.title: What should people find?
slides.body: List the sources and where they live today: a shared drive, a wiki, a ticketing system, an inbox.

slides.title: Which searches use exact IDs?
slides.body: Order numbers, part codes, policy codes. If staff search by them, plan for hybrid search (meaning plus keywords) from day one.

slides.title: Who's allowed to see what?
slides.body: Write it down before anything is indexed, and make sure the rules get checked on every search.

slides.title: What if nothing matches?
slides.body: Search by meaning always returns something. Ask how the system tells you it came up empty.

slides.title: How will you know it works?
slides.body: A few dozen real questions with the right answers. Test every version against them, and exact IDs separately.

slides.title: When an answer is wrong
slides.body: Ask to see which passages were retrieved. That shows whether the search failed or the written answer did.
